integrity: All finite volume and replacement claims have a self-contained exact Q(sqrt(5)) checker; no independent audit or historical priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Proven for a unit-edge regular icosidodecahedron. Continuous maximum and equality classification are global; second-level volume and 27-level spectrum are restricted to vertex-supported tetrahedra. An unindexed exact classical table could affect priority.
title: Maximum tetrahedra in the regular icosidodecahedron and their twenty facial families
